excerpt: Provide platform services to businesses that collect payments from their own customers.
Collect payments from customers and automatically pay out a portion to sellers or service providers on your marketplace.
Create a unified identity to represent each of your platform's connected accounts with one or more configurations, such as merchant or customer.
You embed the Account onboarding component directly in your application and your connected accounts go through the onboarding flow without leaving your application.
API onboarding: You use the Stripe API to build your own customized onboarding UI.
Create a charge and split payments between your platform and your sellers or service providers.
Pay out to connected accounts: Manage payouts and external accounts for your connected accounts.
platforms can implement a range of pricing strategies for different payment processing use-cases, without the need to write any code
Manage connected accounts with the Dashboard: Review and take action on your connected accounts.
Embed Treasury in your platform to allow your customers to hold funds, pay bills, earn cash back, and manage cashflow.
Issue cards at platform scale. Create, distribute, and manage virtual and physical cards.
Connect platforms and marketplaces can allow their connected accounts to access their balances immediately following a successful charge.
Schedule the frequency of automatic payouts
Before going live, test your Connect integration for account creation, identity verification, and payouts.
All Connect integrations should establish a webhook endpoint to listen for Connect events.
Use identity verification to reduce risk on your platform when using Connect.
You can view all disputes filed against your platform and connected accounts in your Dashboard.
To check the balance of a connected account, perform a retrieve balance call authenticated as the connected account.
